title: Example DS — make shared choices easier to find

problem.text: Both apps already use shared components alongside local components. The source alone does not establish whether the local components should become shared.

practices.text: Publish foundation guidance alongside components. Primer documents colour, typography and layout as foundations of its product interfaces.

assumptions.text: For this synthetic walkthrough, assume the team wants clearer guidance on when to reuse a shared component. No team interview was conducted.

after.text: Keep the existing shared package and add guidance for choosing shared versus local components. Validate the guidance in one representative task before changing component ownership.

architecture.title: Preserve the package; clarify how apps use it

plan.title: Confirm the reuse boundary
plan.changes: Review the dashboard notice and portal header with the team before proposing shared replacements.
plan.why: Local usage is measured, but duplication or harm is not established.
plan.verification: Record the intended owner and reason for keeping or sharing each component.

plan.title: Write and try a usage example
plan.changes: Add a short guide next to the shared package and try it on a representative contributor task.
plan.why: The pilot can test whether the guidance answers a real question.
plan.verification: Observe a developer finding and applying the guidance; rerun the unfiltered audit and consumers report. Counts alone do not prove improvement.
